status.description: Omitted: published on create; on update it keeps its status (only an explicit `published` publishes a draft, and a published assessment cannot become a draft again).

submissions.description: How many of the classroom's enrolled students have submitted it; for the classroom's teacher only.

has_submissions.description: Whether any student has submitted it, students since removed from the classroom included: once one has, it can no longer be replaced, and deleting it needs with_submissions=true. For the classroom's teacher only.

origin.description: Left out for a question the teacher wrote.

id.description: Ignored; every saved question gets a new id, except one left unchanged on a published assessment, which keeps its id and the work students saved on it.
